options: How to sign up at Green Teens
questions.question:
[지문]
A: Hello, teens! Do you want to make the world better? Then, join Green Teens! Our goal is to stop global warming. For this, we do various activities. For example, we hold zero-waste challenges and tree planting events. Interested? Then, join us! I hope we can make a difference together.

다음 글 뒤에 이어질 내용으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: Green Teens에 참여하도록 유도하는 글이므로, 마지막에는 실제로 가입하는 방법이 이어져야 한다.

questions.question:
[지문]
글의 흐름상 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은?

It does various activities such as cleaning up beaches and helping dolphins.

I grew up in Jeju-do, so I had many chances to see dolphins. ( ① ) Then, I learned that many dolphins are in danger. ( ② ) Some are even endangered. ( ③ ) I thought I should do something. ( ④ ) So, I searched the Internet and found an NGO, Dolphin Lovers. ( ⑤ ) After some thought, I joined it today.
questions.explanation: 주어진 문장 'It does various activities such as cleaning up beaches and helping dolphins.'는 Dolphin Lovers가 하는 활동을 설명하므로, Dolphin Lovers를 찾은 직후에 그 단체의 활동을 소개하는 ⑤ 위치에 삽입되어야 한다.

questions.question:
[지문]
This afternoon, I took part in a training class for Halla and Olle, two dolphins in an aquarium in Jeju-do. The latest project of Dolphin Lovers is to return them to the sea. For this, Halla and Olle first need to learn some skills. They will need them to survive in the wild. I really wanted to be part of the project. Luckily, I got the chance. I just ran some errands in the training class today, but the experience made me so excited.

Today, Halla and Olle went back to the sea. There was a small ceremony, and all the members of Dolphin Lovers were there. The ceremony made us quite emotional. In fact, I cried a little. Now I cannot see Halla and Olle anymore! However, I was very happy at the same time.

다음 글에 나타난 'I'의 심경 변화로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 처음에는 훈련 수업에 참여하여 '흥분(excited)'했고, 돌핀들이 바다로 돌아가는 것을 보며 '감동(touched)'을 느낀다.

options: A long story about Inho and Aunt Sumi's past.
A story about the next volunteer activity he did that afternoon.
A science explanation about plastic waste in the sea.
A closing sentence ending the blog post for the day.
A chart comparing 'Dolphin Lovers' with other groups.
questions.question:
[지문]
Many dolphins get sick or even die because of plastic waste and fishing nets, so cleaning up beaches is important. There was a beach cleanup party today, and I took part in it. Cleaning up the beach was not easy, but I enjoyed it. Oh, I saw Aunt Sumi there. She is also a member of Dolphin Lovers. What a small world!

다음 글의 마지막 문장 이후에 이어질 내용으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 블로그 포스트의 마지막 부분이므로 하루의 활동을 정리하는 마무리 문장이 가장 적절하다.

options: He is telling a story to the dolphins.
He is happy that his hard work is finished.
He is warning them to be careful in the sea.
He is wishing the dolphins a happy and free life in the wild.
He is ordering the dolphins to leave the aquarium right now.
questions.question:
[지문]
Today, Halla and Olle went back to the sea. There was a small ceremony, and all the members of Dolphin Lovers were there. The ceremony made us quite emotional. In fact, I cried a little. Now I cannot see Halla and Olle anymore! However, I was very happy at the same time. After 10 years of hard life in an aquarium, now all the sea is their home. "Live freely and happily ever after!" I shouted and waved goodbye to them.

다음 글의 밑줄 친 "Live freely and happily ever after!"가 맥락상 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 10년간 수족관의 힘든 생활을 한 돌핀들이 이제 자유롭게 살기를 바라는 마음을 담은 인사말이다.

questions.question:
[지문]
A: I have a math test tomorrow.
B: Good luck, Minsu. I hope you do well on it.
A: Thanks, but I'm a little nervous. I don't think I'm well prepared.
B: Don't worry. You'll do fine.

다음 대화에 드러난 'Minsu'의 심경으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: Minsu는 "I'm a little nervous"와 "I don't think I'm well prepared"라고 말하므로 걱정하고 불안한 심경을 보이고 있다.

questions.question:
[지문]
I grew up in Jeju-do, so I had many chances to see dolphins. Then, I learned that many dolphins are in danger. Some are even endangered. I thought I should do something. So, I searched the Internet and found an NGO, Dolphin Lovers. It does various activities such as cleaning up beaches and helping dolphins. After some thought, I joined it today.

Many dolphins get sick or even die because plastic waste and fishing nets, so cleaning up beaches is important. There was a beach cleanup party today, and I took part in it. Cleaning up the beach was not easy, but I enjoyed it. Oh, I saw Aunt Sumi there. She is also a member of Dolphin Lovers. What a small world!

다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?
questions.explanation: "Many dolphins get sick or even die because plastic waste and fishing nets"에서 "because of"가 되어야 한다. because 뒤에는 절(clause)이 와야 하지만, 여기서는 명사구가 오므로 "because of"가 올바른 형태이다.

questions.question:
[지문]
A: Hello, teens! Do you want to make the world better? Then, join Green Teens! ① <u>Our</u> goal is to stop global warming. ② <u>For this</u>, we do various activities. ③ <u>For example</u>, we hold zero-waste challenges and tree planting events. ④ <u>Many</u> teens find these activities difficult. ⑤ <u>Interested</u> ? Then, join us! I hope we can make a difference together.

다음 글에서 전체 흐름과 관계없는 문장은?
questions.explanation: "Many teens find these activities difficult."는 Green Teens에 참여하도록 유도하는 전체 흐름과 맞지 않는다. 나머지는 모두 참여를 권유하는 내용으로 일관되어 있다.

questions.question:
[지문]
I grew up in Jeju-do, so I had many chances to see dolphins. Then, I learned that many dolphins are in danger. Some are even endangered. I thought I should do something. So, I searched the Internet and found an NGO, Dolphin Lovers. It does various activities such as cleaning up beaches and helping dolphins. After some thought, I joined it today.

Many dolphins get sick or even die because of plastic waste and fishing nets, so cleaning up beaches is important. There was a beach cleanup party today, and I took part in it. Cleaning up the beach was not easy, but I enjoyed it. Oh, I saw Aunt Sumi there. She is also a member of Dolphin Lovers. What a small world!

This afternoon, I took part in a training class for Halla and Olle, two dolphins in an aquarium in Jeju-do. The latest project of Dolphin Lovers is to return them to the sea. For this, Halla and Olle first need to learn some skills. They will need them to survive in the wild. I really wanted to be part of the project. Luckily, I got the chance. I just ran some errands in the training class today, but the experience made me so excited.

Today, Halla and Olle went back to the sea. There was a small ceremony, and all the members of Dolphin Lovers were there. The ceremony made us quite emotional. In fact, I cried a little. Now I cannot see Halla and Olle anymore! However, I was very happy at the same time. After 10 years of hard life in an aquarium, now all the sea is their home. "Live freely and happily ever after!" I shouted and waved goodbye to them.

다음 글의 내용을 한 문장으로 요약하고자 한다. 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

After realizing that dolphins were in ___(A)___, Inho joined an NGO and participated in various activities, which gave him a sense of ___(B)___ despite the sadness of parting.
questions.explanation: (A) 돌핀들이 위험에 처해 있다는 것을 깨달았으므로 "danger". (B) 여러 활동 참여를 통해 '성취감(fulfillment)'을 느꼈다.

options: to tell A the exact ranking of the school dancers
to give A confidence and cheer her up
to ask A if she is sure about winning the prize
to say bad things about other dancers
to advise A to practice harder for the contest
questions.question:
[지문]
A: I have a dance contest tomorrow. I'm a little worried.
B: You'll do great. (A) I think you're the best dancer in our school.
A: Do you really think so?
B: Of course. I hope you win first prize.

다음 밑줄 친 (A)에 드러나는 B의 의도로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: B는 A를 격려하고 자신감을 주기 위해 "You're the best dancer"라고 말하고 있다.

options: He went to the library to learn more.
It is important to learn from mistakes.
I have a lot of homework to do.
My hobby is to take pictures.
questions.question:
[지문]
You can work with NGOs as a teenager. It is a great way to learn about social issues and make the world better. Are you interested? Then, read Inho's blog below.

다음 글의 밑줄 친 to learn과 어법상 쓰임이 같은 것은?
questions.explanation: 원문의 "It is a great way to learn about social issues"는 목적을 나타내는 부정사(to-infinitive for purpose)이고, ②의 "He went to the library to learn more"도 같은 용법이다.

options: A is sure that she will win the first prize.
A wants to confirm that she is a good dancer.
A thinks B is praising her too much.
A is worried because she has never joined a contest.
A does not think B's opinion is important.
questions.question:
[지문]
A: I have a dance contest tomorrow. I'm a little worried.
B: You'll do great. I think you're the best dancer in our school.
A: Do you really think so?
B: Of course. I hope you win first prize.

다음 대화를 읽고 A에 대해 추론할 수 있는 내용으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: A가 "Do you really think so?"라고 질문하는 것은 B의 평가가 정말 사실인지 확인하고 싶어한다는 의도로, 자신이 좋은 댄서인지 확인하려는 것이다.

questions.question:
다음 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 어법상 틀린 부분을 찾아 옳게 고친 것은?

Today, Halla and Olle ⓐgo back to the sea. There was a small ceremony, and all the members of Dolphin Lovers were there. The ceremony made us quite ⓑemotional. In fact, I cried a little. Now I cannot see Halla and Olle ⓒanytime! However, I was very ⓓhappy at the same time. After 10 years of hard life in an aquarium, now all the sea ⓔis their home.
questions.explanation: ⓒ anytime → anymore가 정답입니다. 'cannot see ~ anymore'는 더 이상 볼 수 없다는 의미이며, anytime은 어떤 시간이든 가능하다는 의미로 문맥에 맞지 않습니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것을 <보기>에서 모두 고른 것은?

Many dolphins get sick or even die because of plastic waste and fishing nets, so cleaning up beaches is important. There was a beach cleanup party today, and I took part in it. Cleaning up the beach was not easy, but I enjoyed it. Oh, I saw Aunt Sumi there. She is also a member of Dolphin Lovers. What a small world!

<보기>
a. Dolphins are threatened by marine trash such as plastic and nets.
b. The writer felt that the beach cleanup activity was not so hard.
c. Aunt Sumi visited the beach to meet her nephew, the writer.
d. The writer and Aunt Sumi belong to the same organization.
e. The writer thought the enjoyment was bigger than the difficulty.
questions.explanation:
a. 돌고래는 플라스틱과 그물 같은 해양 쓰레기로 위협받음 - 참(글에서 'dolphins get sick or even die because of plastic waste and fishing nets')
d. 저자와 숨이 아주머니가 같은 조직에 속함 - 참(둘 다 Dolphin Lovers의 멤버)
e. 저자는 즐거움이 어려움보다 크다고 생각함 - 참(글에서 'was not easy, but I enjoyed it'으로 즐거움이 더 큼)
b는 거짓(not so hard가 아니라 not easy라고 함)
c는 거짓(만남이 우연이지 만나기 위해 온 것이 아님)

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

This afternoon, I took part in a training class for Halla and Olle, two dolphins in an aquarium in Jeju-do. The latest project of Dolphin Lovers is to return them to the sea. For this, Halla and Olle first need to learn some skills. They will need them to survive in the wild. I really wanted to be part of the project. Luckily, I got the chance. I just ________________________________ in the training class today, but the experience made me so excited.
questions.explanation: 문맥상 저자는 자신이 중요한 역할을 하지 않았지만(just), 경험이 흥미로웠다는 의미를 전달합니다. 'ran some errands'(여러 심부름을 했다)가 이 의미에 가장 부합합니다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

I grew up in Jeju-do, so I had many chances to see dolphins. ___________, I learned that many dolphins are in danger. Some are even endangered. I thought I should do something.
questions.explanation: '많은 기회가 있었다'는 첫 번째 문장에서, '그러나 위험에 처한 돌고래가 많다는 것을 알았다'는 두 번째 문장으로 시간 순서대로 진행되므로 'Then'(그러면, 그 후)이 가장 적절합니다.

options: They were released into the wild immediately after being caught.
They have lived in the aquarium for a ten years before their release.
They showed aggressive behavior during the release ceremony.
They will continue to be trained by Dolphin Lovers in the sea.
They were visited by the writer frequently while they were in the wild.
questions.question:
Halla와 Olle에 관한 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

Today, Halla and Olle went back to the sea. There was a small ceremony, and all the members of Dolphin Lovers were there. The ceremony made us quite emotional. In fact, I cried a little. Now I cannot see Halla and Olle anymore! However, I was very happy at the same time. After 10 years of hard life in an aquarium, now all the sea is their home. "Live freely and happily ever after!" I shouted and waved goodbye to them.
questions.explanation: 글에서 'After 10 years of hard life in an aquarium'이라고 명시되어 있으므로, 그들은 방생 전에 수족관에서 10년을 살았습니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?

I grew up in Jeju-do, so I had many chances (A) [to see / seeing] dolphins. Then, I learned that many dolphins are in danger. Some are even endangered. I thought I should do something. So, I searched the Internet and found an NGO, Dolphin Lovers. It does various activities such as (B) [clean / cleaning] up beaches and helping dolphins. After some thought, I joined it today. Many dolphins get sick or even die (C) [because / because of] plastic waste and fishing nets, so cleaning up beaches is important.
questions.explanation: (A) have chances to do(~할 기회가 있다)이므로 to see. (B) such as 뒤에는 동명사를 사용하므로 cleaning. (C) 명사(plastic waste)가 뒤에 따라오므로 because of를 사용합니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중 어법상 어색한 것은?

A: You look a little worried, Somi.
B: Well, I just joined the NGO VANK. Remember? You once talked about it in class.
A: Of course, I do. Its main goal is to introduce Korea to the world.
B: You know, I'm interested in Korean history and culture.
A: Then, it's the perfect choice for you. So, what are you worried about?
B: Well, it's just ... my English is not ①enough good.
A: Oh, don't worry, Somi. Your English is OK. You'll ②do fine.
B: Do you really think so?
A: Sure. I just hope you ③have a chance ④to learn more about Korean history.
B: Thanks, Mr. Hopkins. I'll ⑤do my best.
questions.explanation: 'enough good'은 어법상 틀렸습니다. 올바른 표현은 'good enough'입니다. enough는 형용사 뒤에 위치합니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?

A: I hear you're going on a trip to Jeju-do tomorrow. Have a great time!
B: Thanks, but I don't think I (A) [can / do]. I don't feel (B) [good / well].
A: Oh, no. What's wrong?
B: I have a (C) [terrible / terribly] cold.
A: I'm so sorry. I just hope you feel better soon.
questions.explanation: (A) can: 조동사 can이 필요합니다. (B) well: 'feel'은 감각동사로 형용사(good)가 아닌 부사(well)를 사용합니다. (C) terrible: 'a cold'라는 명사를 수식하므로 형용사 terrible을 사용합니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 문맥상 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

Many dolphins get sick or even die because of plastic waste and fishing nets, so cleaning up beaches is ⓐimportant. There was a beach cleanup party today, and I took part in it. Cleaning up the beach was not ⓑeasy, but I ⓒhated it. Oh, I saw Aunt Sumi there. She is also a ⓓmember of Dolphin Lovers. What a ⓔsmall world!
questions.explanation: ⓒ 'hated it'는 문맥상 적절하지 않습니다. 앞 문장에서 'not easy, but I enjoyed it'이라는 의미가 일반적이므로, 'hated'는 전체 맥락과 맞지 않습니다. 원문에서는 'enjoyed it'으로 표현됩니다.

questions.question:
다음 글을 읽고 'Halla와 Olle의 방생 프로젝트'에 관해 추론할 수 있는 내용을 <보기>에서 모두 고른 것은?

This afternoon, I took part in a training class for Halla and Olle, two dolphins in an aquarium in Jeju-do. The latest project of Dolphin Lovers is to return them to the sea. For this, Halla and Olle first need to learn some skills. They will need them to survive in the wild. I really wanted to be part of the project. Luckily, I got the chance. I just ran some errands in the training class today, but the experience made me so excited. Today, Halla and Olle went back to the sea. There was a small ceremony, and all the members of Dolphin Lovers were there. The ceremony made us quite emotional. In fact, I cried a little. Now I cannot see Halla and Olle anymore! However, I was very happy at the same time. After 10 years of hard life in an aquarium, now all the sea is their home. "Live freely and happily ever after!" I shouted and waved goodbye to them.

<보기>
ㄱ. The training time was necessary because the dolphins lost their ability to live in the wild
ㄴ. Training the dolphins needed experts, not just regular volunteers.
ㄷ. All the training and the release were finished in one day.
questions.explanation:
ㄱ. 거짓 - 글에서 훈련이 필요한 이유는 야생에서 생존하는 데 필요한 기술을 배우기 위함이지, 능력을 잃어서가 아닙니다.
ㄴ. 참 - 글에서 저자는 단순히 심부름을 했을 뿐(ran some errands)이므로 전문가가 훈련을 담당함을 암시합니다.
ㄷ. 거짓 - 글은 오후에 훈련에 참여하고 나중에(Today) 방생했으므로 다른 날입니다.

options: To clean up the beach completely
To run some errands in the class
To keep them in the aquarium safely
To return Halla and Olle to the sea
To make the writer excited about the project
questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 'For this'가 가리키는 내용으로 가장 적절한 것은?

This afternoon, I took part in a training class for Halla and Olle, two dolphins in an aquarium in Jeju-do. The latest project of Dolphin Lovers is to return them to the sea. For this, Halla and Olle first need to learn some skills. They will need them to survive in the wild. I really wanted to be part of the project. Luckily, I got the chance. I just ran some errands in the training class today, but the experience made me so excited.
questions.explanation: 'For this'는 바로 앞 문장의 'to return them to the sea'를 가리킵니다. 돌고래들이 기술을 배워야 하는 목적은 그들을 바다로 돌려보내기 위함입니다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어의 쓰임이 문맥상 적절하지 않은 것은? (단, 선택지는 원문의 단어를 변형하여 출제함)

Today, Halla and Olle went back to the sea. There was a small ceremony, and all the members of Dolphin Lovers were there. The ceremony made us quite (a) sentimental. In fact, I cried a little. Now I cannot see Halla and Olle anymore! However, I was very (b) delighted at the same time. After 10 years of (c) severe life in an aquarium, now all the sea is their home. "Live (d) independently and happily ever after!" I shouted and waved goodbye to them.
questions.explanation: (c) 'severe life'는 문맥상 적절하지 않습니다. 'severe'는 '엄격한, 심각한'의 의미이고, 여기서는 '힘든, 어려운' 의미의 'hard life'가 원문에 있으며 더 적절합니다. 'Difficult' 또는 'tough'가 더 자연스럽습니다.

questions.question:
(A), (B), (C)의 각 네모 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?

I grew up in Jeju-do, so I had many chances to see dolphins. Then, I learned that many dolphins are in danger. Some are even (A) [ endangered / endangering ]. I thought I should do something.

So, I searched the Internet and found an NGO, Dolphin Lovers. It does various activities such as (B) [ clean / cleaning ] up beaches and helping dolphins. After some thought, I joined it today.

Many dolphins get sick or even die because of plastic waste and fishing nets, so cleaning up beaches is important. There was a beach cleanup party today, and I took part in it. Cleaning up the beach was not easy, but I enjoyed it. Oh, I saw Aunt Sumi there. She is also a member of Dolphin Lovers. What a small world!

This afternoon, I took part in a training class for Halla and Olle, two dolphins in an aquarium in Jeju-do.

The latest project of Dolphin Lovers is to return them to the sea. For this, Halla and Olle first need to learn some skills. They will need them to survive in the wild. I really wanted to be part of the project. Luckily, I got the chance. I just ran some errands in the training class today, but the experience made me so excited.

Today, Halla and Olle went back to the sea. There was a small ceremony, and all the members of Dolphin Lovers were there. The ceremony made us quite (C) [ emotional / emotionally ].
questions.explanation: (A) 돌고래들이 멸종 위기에 처해진 상태(수동)이므로 과거분사 'endangered'가 적절하다. (B) 전치사 as 뒤에 명사가 올 위치이므로 동명사 'cleaning'이 적절하다. (C) 뒤에 명사구(ceremony)가 오지 않고 동사 'made'의 목적어 보어로 형용사가 필요하므로 'emotional'이 적절하다.
